trips.name: Iguazu National Park
trips.description: Explore the stunning Iguazu Falls and surrounding subtropical rainforest, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

trips.name: Guira Oga Wildlife Rescue
trips.description: Visit a wildlife rehabilitation center dedicated to rescuing and caring for injured native animals.

trips.name: Minas de Wanda
trips.description: Discover the famous semi-precious gemstone mines of Wanda, known for amethyst and quartz crystals.

trips.name: Jesuitical Missions
trips.description: Full-day excursion to the historic Jesuit missions, a UNESCO World Heritage Site showcasing colonial-era history.

trips.name: Parque Nacional Do Iguaçu
trips.description: Experience the Brazilian side of Iguazu Falls with panoramic views of the Devil's Throat.

trips.name: Parque Das Aves
trips.description: Walk through aviaries housing over 1,300 birds of 130 species in the Atlantic Forest.
